title: 'Sacred Jewel': Historical K-drama starring Ahn Bo-hyun, Claudia Kim gets Dec. 5 premiere
summary: The Korean historical drama 'Sacred Jewel,' which stars Ahn Bo-hyun and Claudia Kim, will be available to stream for Filipino audiences on Prime Video starting December 5.
